$comment: PROTO-ACTIVATION-001 A7: rlp-266-identity-ceremony-v1 was approved by the Executive exactly as stated here (CBD266-IDENTITY-RECORDS-001 revision 2, 2026-09-14, actor atlassian:5cffa74b92e6c70c53499977; its candidate digest 2a21ca1d477e4c1d881fcaa981c1dee423f6155b733ed91b00c81881527805db is recorded in config/rate-limit/approvals.json). It is not projected into config/rate-limit/records.json because the registry admits one approved record per surface (packages/rate-limit/src/registry.ts, record_reference_invalid /surface_id) and rlp-266-bootstrap-v1 already holds surf-266-authentication; projecting both invalidates the whole registry (verified mechanically in the PROTO-ACTIVATION-001 correction round). Until the Executive supersedes or re-surfaces one of the two records, the four ceremony routes stay bound to rlp-266-bootstrap-v1 with the real ceremony id and stage in the counting key. The companion rlp-266-identity-session-v1 record is projected and active.

safe_counting_key.rotation_behavior: dual-read/single-write for at least 120000 ms; carry forward the greater count
safe_counting_key.privacy_basis: No subject locator is used before authentication; the loopback transport cohort is the only counted dimension (AL-266-001).

anti_lockout_rule.pool_isolation: Pre-authentication identity ceremony routes (begin, callback, local hosted ceremony) count by network cohort plus exact surface only; no claimed subject, e-mail or state value is a counting dimension, so an attacker cannot exhaust a victim pool by naming it (AL-266-001). The pool is isolated from every post-authentication pool and from the public health exception.
anti_lockout_rule.reset_authority: local prototype operator / restore counter service only
anti_lockout_rule.notification_behavior: uniform and content-safe; reveals neither existence nor remaining quota
anti_lockout_rule.rationale: Pre-authentication identity ceremony routes (begin, callback, local hosted ceremony) count by network cohort plus exact surface only; no claimed subject, e-mail or state value is a counting dimension, so an attacker cannot exhaust a victim pool by naming it (AL-266-001). The pool is isolated from every post-authentication pool and from the public health exception.

capacity_basis.evidence_locator: PROTO-IDENTITY-API-001 / single-local-process planning basis; PROPOSED, not approved
capacity_basis.sustained_capacity: 2 ceremonies/second in one local process; not measured - Implementation estimate dated 2026-09-13
capacity_basis.peak_assumption: At most 15 ceremony requests in 60 seconds per cohort; at least 87% request-rate headroom against the estimate
capacity_basis.headroom: At most 15 ceremony requests in 60 seconds per cohort; at least 87% request-rate headroom against the estimate
capacity_basis.failure_budget: zero uncounted protected effects when the store is unavailable or uncertain
workload_assumptions: One developer, one process, loopback traffic, local Cognito-shaped adapter, no hosted provider
